children: America's Car-Mart entered into an extension of its First Amendment and Limited Waiver under its Credit and Guaranty Agreement to continue covenant and reporting default waivers. On September 4, 2026, Silver Point Finance, as agent, and the lenders extended the waiver period through September 11, 2026. The relief supports the company as it evaluates strategic and financing alternatives and works with stakeholders. There is no assurance a permanent waiver or broader transaction will be completed.
